name: Kelm Hargunth
summary: At Mor'shan Base Camp, Kelm Hargunth keeps the Warsong Outriders supplied. He sends provisions and care packages to Horde champions fighting night elves in Warsong Gulch.

sections.title: Quartermaster of Mor'shan
sections.body: Kelm Hargunth manages supplies for the Warsong Outriders at Mor'shan Base Camp. The camp sits on the northern edge of the Barrens, beside Ashenvale. Beyond its stockade, scouts and raiders skirmish. Kelm sends weapons, armor, and rations to the fighters. The Warsong Outriders face the Silverwing Sentinels, so steady provisions matter as much as fury in battle.

sections.title: Supplying the Front
sections.body: Kelm gives special supplies to warriors who have proven themselves in Warsong Gulch. His stores hold care packages with field dressings and iron rations. He also offers weapons marked with the Warsong clan's crimson insignia. These supplies support fighters serving the Horde's campaign in the forests to the north.

faq.answer: Kelm Hargunth is an orc supply officer for the Warsong Outriders. At Mor'shan Base Camp in the northern Barrens, he gives Horde soldiers weapons, armor, and provisions for fighting in Warsong Gulch.
Kelm Hargunth is stationed at Mor'shan Base Camp on the far northern edge of the Barrens. The camp lies beside the rampart divide leading into Ashenvale.

faq.q: What faction does Kelm Hargunth serve?
faq.answer: Kelm Hargunth serves the Warsong Outriders, the Horde vanguard seeking lumber and territory in southern Ashenvale against the night elves.

faq.q: What are the care packages Kelm offers?
faq.answer: Kelm Hargunth offers Basic, Standard, and Advanced Care Packages to frontline fighters. They hold battlefield sundries, bandages, and rations for Horde combatants in the gulch.

faq.q: Why is Mor'shan Base Camp so important to the Warsong?
faq.answer: Mor'shan Base Camp is a fortified staging ground and checkpoint between the Barrens and Ashenvale. From there, the Warsong clan moves supplies, reinforcements, and harvested timber safely into Horde lands.

faq.q: What kind of gear does Kelm Hargunth provide?
faq.answer: Kelm Hargunth provides proven fighters with Warsong battle tabards, special weapons such as the Scout's Blade and Legionnaire's Sword, tailored armor sets, rings, and battlefield draughts for close-quarters skirmishing.

angles.text: As a Horde soldier, you can fight the night elves in Warsong Gulch. Kelm Hargunth provides the tools of war.
As an orc, you see Grom Hellscream's legacy carried on in Ashenvale as Hargunth keeps the Warsong clan armed and fed.
As a warrior, you rely on Hargunth's sturdy plate leggings, heavy blades, and combat rations to hold the line against the Alliance.
